const db = require('../database');

const utils = module.exports;

// internal token management utilities only

utils.log = async (token) => {
	await db.sortedSetAdd('tokens:lastSeen', Date.now(), token);
};

utils.getLastSeen = async tokens => await db.sortedSetScores('tokens:lastSeen', tokens);

item.text: The database helpers support the required object and sorted set operations across the repository’s backends. I’ll expose the lifecycle methods under `api.utils.tokens`, store creation and ownership in sorted indexes, and hydrate reads with numeric timestamps and last-seen values. I’ll also make bearer authentication recognize tokens created through the new utility while preserving existing settings-backed tokens.
